// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/prompt-commands: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const PROMPT_COMMANDS_READ_PERMISSION = "commands:read";

export declare const PROMPT_COMMAND_LIMITS: {
    readonly files: 100;
    readonly bytes: number;
    readonly name: 80;
};

export declare const PROMPT_COMMAND_LOCATIONS: readonly [".molis/commands", ".claude/commands"];

export interface PromptCommand extends PromptCommandPlace {
    readonly description: string;
    readonly argument_hint: string | null;
    readonly takes_arguments: boolean;
    readonly text: string;
}

export type PromptCommandFile = PromptCommand | PromptCommandUnreadable;

export type PromptCommandLocation = (typeof PROMPT_COMMAND_LOCATIONS)[number];

export type PromptCommandProblem = "front-matter" | "too-large" | "not-text" | "link" | "unreadable";

export interface PromptCommandUnreadable extends PromptCommandPlace {
    readonly unreadable: PromptCommandProblem;
}

export declare const personalPromptCommandsCapability: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, {
    commands: PromptCommandFile[];
}>;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface PromptCommandPlace {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly location: PromptCommandLocation;
    readonly path: string;
}
